timcosing, itscoming, replaceme, corncakes, and intervene all have nine letters. If you assign their letters the numbers 1 through 9, and then form a six-letter word by using the pattern 124185, you get:

 

timcosing: tictno

itscoming: itcino

replaceme: relrma

corncakes: concec

intervene: ineinr

 

I have tried all five of those as replacements for replaceme in the URL. They all lead to Page not found.

 

As noted, there are nine numbered pages in the rulebook. There are also ten sections of bio, one for each villain. I tried matching phrases from the 'itscoming' page to the various bios, hoping that I'd somehow find that there were nine sets of text that matched, and then I could try reordering the text according to the six digit pattern, but I couldn't match any of the text aside from unhelpfully small sets of words.

Flavor text sources for the /itscoming line. Of course, it's from nine different cards.

the worst part between what you see and what actually is, the only truth now. You shall not feel my bones The protection of the most awful future Indeed...You are not real.

  1. Enclave of the Endlings - Gruum - "Gruum was very strong, yes. And Gruum was tough as well. La Capitan's crew couldn't even slow its charge. But the worst part was the constant yelling."
  2. Miss Information (VotM) - Endless Possibilities - "There are worlds of difference between what you see and what actually is, Maia"
  3. Realm of Discord – Negative Energy Field – “Everything burned. Moving hurt, but staying in one place was worse. No matter what happened, one thing was clear: pain was the only truth now.”
  4. Nightmist – Oblivion - "You shall not enter this world!"-Nightmist, Nightmist #22
  5. La Capitan – Chronological Hotspot – “Augh! This pain I can feel my bones tearing me apart!"
  6. The Naturalist – Indomitable Force – "The protection of innocence is the purest venture." The Naturalist, Cosmic Concurrence #7
  7. The Visionary – Demoralization – "Visions of the most awful future can be rather disheartening." -The Visionary, Mind Over Matter #43
  8. Apostate – Apocalypse - "Indeed…perish you shall!" -Apostate, Absolution #19
  9. Infinitor – Lambent Reaper - "You are not real. You can still hurt me. This is not what I wanted today." -Sky-Scraper, Cosmic Concurrence #23
